text: Arcadia Hotels reported revenue per available room of $142.60 in 2025, compared with $133.10 in 2024. Occupancy averaged 74.2%.
The portfolio included 286 hotels with 51,400 rooms at year end. Franchised properties made up 61% of rooms.
Adjusted EBITDA was $918 million in 2025, up from $842 million in 2024, while net income was $305 million.
Loyalty program membership grew to 38.5 million members, and members accounted for 57% of room nights.
Capital returned to shareholders totaled $640 million, consisting of $410 million in buybacks and $230 million in dividends.
Foxglove Semiconductors shipped 412 million units in fiscal 2025, versus 365 million units in fiscal 2024.
Data center revenue was $1.86 billion and automotive revenue was $744 million in fiscal 2025.
Gross margin expanded to 58.6% in fiscal 2025 from 54.9% in fiscal 2024 as factory utilization improved.
Research and development expense was $612 million, representing 21.4% of revenue.
Inventory days on hand fell to 118 from 142 a year earlier. The company ended fiscal 2025 with 7,250 employees.
Lakewood Insurance wrote $3.05 billion of net premiums in 2025, an increase from $2.79 billion in 2024.
The combined ratio was 96.8% in 2025 and 101.3% in 2024. Catastrophe losses added 4.7 points to the 2025 ratio.
Net investment income was $268 million, and the investment portfolio yielded 4.1%.
Policies in force reached 2.36 million at December 31, 2025. Customer retention was 87%.
Book value per share was $48.20 at year end 2025, compared with $44.75 at year end 2024.
Meridian Rail carried 9.8 million passengers in 2025, up from 8.9 million in 2024, across 1,140 route miles.
Ticket revenue was $486 million and ancillary revenue was $57 million in 2025.
On-time performance was 88.4% in 2025, down from 91.0% in 2024, because of track maintenance.
The company operated 214 trainsets and took delivery of 18 new trainsets during 2025.
Operating expenses were $498 million, of which labor costs were $231 million.
